findings.claim: The QA route drives the one-paragraph hands-on instructions beginning at html-css-js/html-and-css/forms-and-html5-validation/artifact.html:243, but neither the route nor the artifact presents each task as numbered where-to-look, what-to-type-or-press, what-to-expect, and how-to-know-done steps. The current route can therefore pass while the captain-required instruction shape is absent.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite each hands-on task as an accessible numbered list with explicit where, action, expected result, and done criterion, without exposing the reasoning answer; update the QA path to assert that structure while retaining the same behavioral route.
